definition: [ הוּת ] verb shout at, si vera l . (Arabic with shout at, threaten , dialect. for , compare De Ps 62:4 who camp. Damascene rush upon one with cries and raised fist, compare further Wetzst in De ; so MV SS : Thes and others assign to [ התת ], attack ; text dubious) — only Po. Imperfect תְּהוֺתֲתוּ עַלאִֿישׁ Ps 62:4 but Hup Che read תְּהוֺלֲלוּ be frantic against , compare Ps 102:9 .
